title: Release Vinea 0.2.0 icon and host update workflow

requirements.text: The approved Vine Loop icon is packaged and referenced by the Codex plugin manifest.
Every distributed Vinea artifact derives the released 0.2.0 version from package.json.
Codex and Claude Code refresh through their supported plugin workflows without runtime-cache copying.
The doctor JSON schema regression is repaired without changing production behavior.
The release has test, package, validator, and live dual-host verification evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The public plugin contains the Vine Loop PNG and Codex declares the same relative path for composerIcon, logo, and logoDark.
package.json, generated host manifests, and generated marketplace records report 0.2.0.
Codex reinstalls after a single cachebuster update and Claude Code updates an existing installation before any install fallback.
The doctor JSON focused test passes with migration status none and no rework diagnostics.
npm run check, plugin validation, and post-refresh Codex and Claude Code list checks pass.
